engines.invocation: gate3 runs BOTH engines with --json on the target and requires verdict SAFE with the SAME receipt in {pushed, moved-to-obsidian, stale, metadata-prune}, equal to --expect-receipt when given

claim: Q1 operability: the r7 quarantine execution_plan_template (census/round-7/quarantine-plan.json) is one runnable, self-tested tool

selftest.fixtures: everything under mktemp -d (last run /dev/shm/tmp.91yU7oBKZF-shaped); SHOKUNIN_ROOT and SOUJI_LEDGER pinned into the fixture root so the engines never scan the live fleet or live ledger

scenario_map.T1: pushed happy path end-to-end: gates -> stage -> record sidecar -> second check (pushed re-derived from recorded intro commit) -> retire with signoff (hold waived for pushed per SKILL.md); copy+record removed, nothing else
scenario_map.T2: gate1: local-only commit touching the file -> NOT-AUTHORIZED, stage REFUSED exit 1
scenario_map.T3: gate2: dirty tracked and untracked variants -> NOT-AUTHORIZED
scenario_map.T5: zero-remote repo: explicit `log --branches --not --remotes` form fails CLOSED (count=1) — r6 pitfall proof; bare form on git 2.55.0 observed returning 0 lines (info line in output, not asserted)
scenario_map.T6: secret-shaped path (app.env): refused before any read, check + stage
scenario_map.T7: no SOUJI_Q_SANDBOX: stage REFUSED before any effect, no .ufo-quarantine created; --stage --dry-run needs no sandbox and creates nothing
scenario_map.T9: stale happy path (pushed .gitignore pattern + ignored stale file — the shape that truly classifies stale): mtime preserved by mv, copy-side re-verified by BOTH engines (their sweeps exclude **/.ufo-quarantine/**), hold-not-elapsed refusal, then retire at --hold-min-seconds 0
scenario_map.T10: tampered staged copy: second check FAIL digest-mismatch, retire REFUSED, tampered copy kept for the operator
scenario_map.T12: missing target: NOT-AUTHORIZED unreachable, exit 0 (verdict is data)
scenario_map.T14: usage: no mode / two modes / retire without signoff all exit 2
scenario_map.T15: metadata-prune: worktree registration with absent dir + unique=0 classifies AUTHORIZED but --stage REFUSES stage-unsupported-receipt (retire via worktree tooling, not mv)
scenario_map.T16: moved-to-obsidian full lifecycle: ledger row + matching hashes both sides, source ignored+clean, stage records vault sha, second check re-hashes vault read-only, retire leaves vault untouched
scenario_map.T17: stale candidate with a live reference: gate3 refuses (engines agree NOT-SAFE)
scenario_map.T18: nested stale path: --stage REFUSES nested-stale-unre-verifiable (flattening dir/name -> dir__name breaks the engines' anchored launch-*/​*-draft.* patterns so the mandatory copy-side re-check could never pass)
scenario_map.T19: nested pushed file stages fine to lib__mod.txt and re-verifies
